home.title: Hi, I'm Renato Cruz Jr!
home.subtitle: A little about my life and hobbies
home.about_p1: I was born and raised in São José dos Campos - SP, Brazil. Since an early age, I've always been interested in technology. When I'm not working on projects or at college, I love dedicating time to my hobbies.
home.about_p2: I'm a big music enthusiast, I enjoy playing the guitar, and I also love traveling. I like spending my free time exploring new stories through reading. I'm a curious person who always seeks to learn more about the world.
